source_read: Pret's own product pages (11 category data files fetched 2026-10-08, robots.txt allows /en-GB/products) and its Allergen Guide 8th September 2026 V1 (https://assets.ctfassets.net/4zu8gvmtwqss/11hMIULPpeCprPZIUG76L2/0b636725a4e1551ed7a9817c02c98f31/Allergen_Guide_8th_September_2026_V1.pdf, 22 pages, 20 table pages, sha256 b9cd1255...f474; assets.ctfassets.net has no robots.txt). The 8 Sept guide matrix prints no may-contain.
notes: Independent checks, none using pret.py's own parser for the comparison side: (1) 50 random published items (seeded; 13 with no allergen, 4 barista defaults) loaded in Chromium from their live product pages and the visible 'Contains:' line compared with allergens.csv: 50 of 50 equal (all allergen words seen: Milk 27, Wheat 22, Egg 17, Barley 9, Soya 7, Oats 3, Rye 3, Fish 2, Mustard, Sesame, Pistachio, Almonds). (2) Every one of the 475 guide rows x 29 columns (13,775 cells) pixel-sampled in a 144 dpi render and compared with the text-layer ticks the parser read: 0 mismatching rows, dark-pixel counts cleanly bimodal (0-9 vs 40-79); pages 3, 15 and 20 also read by eye. (3) All 47 barista drinks in a non-default milk listed with their joined guide row (name + milk label): every join read by eye is the right drink and milk. (4) 125 products whose name equals a guide row name: product-page allergens equal the guide row exactly (cereals and nuts kinds too); on all 222 products the allergens printed in bold in the ingredients equal the page's allergen list. Held back (73, holdback.csv, never guessed): 45 decaf variants (the guide has no decaf rows), 17 drinks the guide prints under another name or not at all (4 filter coffee milks, 2 Babyccino milks, 4 Breakfast Tea and 4 Earl Grey Tea choices, 3 Iced Black Americano milks), 6 branded Coke bottles/cans (page says see pack), 5 items declaring Pine Nuts (declared by Pret in addition to the 14; no key in the data model: Avo Olive & Toms Baguette and half, Mortadella Mozzarella & Pistachio Baguette, Avo & Herb Wrap, Chicken Pesto & Rocket Wrap). 13 medium audit flags reviewed with evidence in data/audit/reviewed/pret.csv (satay is soya and coconut sauce with no peanut, lasagne soup has no dairy, almond loaf cakes have no wheat, 'Toasted' is a flavour, the default Matcha Latte uses a coconut drink, Hazelnut Frappe lists only flavouring). Default Matcha Latte allergens come from its own product record (coconut drink, none listed), consistent with the guide's 'Coconut (instead of milk)' row. Pumpkin Spice Latte is joined to the guide's 'Pumpkin Spiced Latte' (one spelling slip: GUIDE_DRINK_NAME).
